answer: The onyx test I would run is Entrusted IT support technician licence with IT service attestation: a licence service officers renew after ticket audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a licence service officers renew after ticket audits stays private; the inlet is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the lantern of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
